findings.summary: Capacity fairness contract cannot enforce per-channel or consecutive-window progress.
findings.details: The approved task requires every runnable channel to advance in each 60-second fairness window or record an exact provider-rate block, with no channel missing two consecutive windows. The submitted BrainCapacityWindow type and evaluator only compare aggregate advancedChannels plus blocked count to runnableChannels. Without channel identities or per-channel missed-window state, a run can satisfy the aggregate count while the same channel starves across consecutive windows, so REL-02/SLK-07 fairness is not contractually proven.
